title: Patient Payment Plans Credit Policy: Late-Fee Record Share of the Add-On Fee
content:
The add-on fee on a Patient Payment Plans plan carries a late-fee record share drawn from the late fees on the patient's Patient Financial Account.

**Measure.** The late fees the Patient Financial Account shows posted less than 24 whole months before the handling date.

**Policy.** The late-fee record share of the fee is 0.90 when the financial account shows no late fee posted less than 24 whole months before the handling date, 0.95 when it shows exactly one such late fee, and 1 when it shows two or more. The share multiplies the tier's setup fee within the scheduled add-on fee, acting on the tier's setup fee itself; the scheduled add-on fee is carried unrounded until the fee is entered.

| Late fees posted less than 24 whole months before the handling date | Late-fee record share |
|---|---|
| None | 0.90 |
| Exactly one | 0.95 |
| Two or more | 1 |

**Examples (hypothetical dates, handling date 1 September 2026).**

- One late fee posted on 15 March 2025 (between 17 and 18 whole months earlier) and none other in the period: 0.95.
- A single late fee posted on 15 June 2024, more than 24 whole months earlier, and none since: no late fee in the period, 0.90.
- Late fees posted on 15 March 2025 and 10 January 2026: 1.
